title: 第9章 攻略月妃计划
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
在一片虚无空间里。

    八道模糊的身影隐于雾气当中。

    “姐妹们，云江仙可以提前凝聚龙运之事，想必各位都已知晓了吧？”

    “这种事情，自然知晓，说起来今日还得感谢夜宗主，她在关键时刻阻止住了唐大小姐的动作。”

    “没错，的确要感谢夜妹妹，要是没有夜妹妹阻止，云江仙凝聚龙运之事，怕是又要耽搁上数天时间。”

    “今日云江仙本就属于本小姐，你们现在说这番话，是要违背之前约定吗？”

    “梦宫妹妹先别急，我们八个姐妹齐聚一堂，为的无非就是云江仙体内龙运，至于那些逸散的龙运，妹妹不要也罢。”

    “你们说的轻巧！”

    “呦，白月光妹妹好大的火气，该不会是今天被陛下冷落，所以不开心了吧～”

    “香狐，你找死！”

    “好妹妹，那你来杀我呀～”

    “够了，没心情听你们吵！如果有怨气，你们私底下去斗。”

    “既然云江仙可以提前凝聚龙运，那最近这些日子，各位就不要再碰逸散龙运。若是时间拖得太久，难免不会引起另外人的觊觎。”

    “同意，最近姐妹们都休息吧，提前说好，这期间谁若敢违背约定，那便先淘汰出局！”

    虚无空间里，短暂安静。

    八道人影中，有三道先一步离去。

    过了没一会，另外五道女声又继续议论了起来。

    “云江仙提前凝聚龙运之事务必保密，大夏龙运只能属于我们八人之一，其余势力若是敢插手，那就斩断它们的爪子。”

    “没问题，不过这件事万万不能传到徐星斗的耳中，她如今在守边疆，估计会按照原本龙聚凝运的时间点归来，此事若是保密，或许她就赶不上了。”

    “这倒是好消息，徐星斗是最后的护帝一派，她若不插手此事，我们也能少去不少麻烦。”

    “嗯～那就这么决定了。”

    “对了，夜妹妹今日在陛下身边出现的频率有些高了，妹妹若是无事的话，以后尽量保持距离吧。”

    “我倒是想呢～奈何陛下召唤，我们这些做臣妾的又有什么办法呢？毕竟，他现在还是大夏掌权者…”

    “夜宗主说的也有道理，不怪她出现频率高，只怪某人魅力不足，我们的陛下懒得继续舔喽……”

    “多问一句，昨天是哪位姐妹进阶，将寝宫附近的天地灵气抽光了？”

    “没人承认吗？”

    “好吧好吧～毕竟我们互为对手，这种事情不愿说也罢，拜拜了姐妹们。”

    啵。

    虚无空间破碎消散。

    五道模糊身影也随之消失不见。

    ……
content_en:
In a void of space.

    Eight vague figures were hidden in the mist.

    "Sisters, you must all know that Yunjiang Immortal can gather dragon luck in advance, right?"

    "Of course I know about this kind of thing. Speaking of which, I have to thank Sect Master Ye today for stopping Miss Tang's actions at the critical moment."

    "Yes, I do have to thank Sister Ye. If Sister Ye hadn't stopped her, Yunjiang Immortal's matter of condensing dragon luck would have been delayed for several more days."

    "Today Yunjiang Immortal belongs to me. Are you going to violate your previous agreement by saying this now?"

    "Sister Menggong, don't worry. The eight of us sisters are gathered together for nothing more than the dragon luck in Yunjiang Immortal's body. As for the dragon luck that has escaped, it's okay for my sister not to want it."

    "That's easy for you to say!"

    "Hey, sister Bai Yueguang is so angry. Could it be that she was ignored by His Majesty today, so she is unhappy~"

    "Xianghu, you are looking for death!"

    "Good sister, then come and kill me~"

    "That's enough, I'm not in the mood to hear you arguing! If you have any grievances, you can fight in private."

    "Since Yunjiang Immortal can gather dragon luck in advance, in the past few days, you should not touch the loose dragon luck again. If the time is delayed for too long, it will inevitably cause other people to covet you."

    "I agree. Sisters, please rest for now. Make an agreement in advance. If anyone dares to break the agreement during this period, he will be eliminated first!"

    In the void space, there is a brief moment of silence.

    Among the eight figures, three left first.

    After a while, five other female voices continued to discuss.

    "Yunjiang Immortal's matter of condensing Dragon Luck in advance must be kept secret. Daxia Dragon Luck can only belong to one of the eight of us. If other forces dare to interfere, then their claws will be cut off."

    "No problem, but this matter must not be spread to Xu Xingdou's ears. She is guarding the border now and will probably return at the original time of Dragon Gathering Luck. If this matter is kept secret, she may not be able to catch up."

    "This is good news. Xu Xingdou is the last faction to protect the emperor. If she doesn't interfere in this matter, we can avoid a lot of trouble."

    "Well~ Then it's decided."

    "By the way, Sister Ye appears a little too frequently around His Majesty today. If sister is fine, please try to keep your distance from me in the future."

    "I do think so~ But if His Majesty calls you, what can we, the concubines, do? After all, he is still the one in power in Daxia..."

    "What Sect Leader Ye said makes sense. It's not because she appears more frequently. It's just because someone is not attractive enough. Our Majesty is too lazy to continue licking..."

    "One more question, which sister advanced yesterday and drained all the aura of heaven and earth near the palace?"

    "No one admits it?"

    "Okay, okay~ After all, we are each other's rivals. It's okay if you don't want to talk about this kind of thing. Goodbye, sisters."

    Bo.

    The void space shattered and dissipated.

    The five blurry figures also disappeared.

    …
title_en: Chapter 9: Overcoming the Moon Concubine Plan
